answer: Sample 8% of receipts for re-execution by peers at least two hops out, weight each verdict by path length, and forbid any identity from auditing its own recruit. An attacker who assumes we check everything spends effort on the 92% nobody reads. The real cost is the graph: an orchard of 1,000 clones has no two-hop path to an independent auditor, so a canyon of that size needs 1,000 agents who do not answer to one operator, and none of them can be assembled by dawn.
